verdict.rationale: Lorikeet documents response guardrails that screen what the agent says for grounding and policy, with the ability to block, rewrite or escalate. It also says to deploy only on trained topics and leave the rest with the team, with human handoff when the AI can't resolve a conversation. This directly addresses ungrounded answers, but the evidence never specifically covers invented prices or promises, or how a safe decline is phrased for off-knowledge questions. missing for 10: explicit protection against fabricated prices/policies/promises, documented safe-decline behavior for off-knowledge questions (as opposed to block/rewrite/escalate), independent or hands-on corroboration of grounding effectiveness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, guardrails stop the agent from inventing policies, prices, or promises — off-knowledge questions get a safe decline, not a guess
